## Summary

- add a dedicated `/forum` page that renders Posts-category GitHub Discussions directly in the browser
- use GitHub REST Discussions API with `application/vnd.github.full+json`, no token required
- show `/forum` as a card list; clicking a card opens `/forum?discussion=<number>` as a full-width post view
- render post detail directly in the center content area instead of inside a nested two-column/card container
- add a small community-contribution banner on post detail pages noting that posts may not reflect the hosts' views
- cache discussion responses in localStorage for 12 hours without exposing cache status in the UI
- add a simple homepage link to the forum

## Verification

- `npx prettier content/forum.md content/index.md quartz/components/pages/Content.tsx quartz/components/scripts/forum.inline.ts --write`
- `npx quartz build`
- `npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false` still reports pre-existing unrelated errors in `EpisodeCarousel.tsx`, `Footer.tsx`, and `GuestSuggestion.tsx`; no forum-related errors

## AI Review Synthesis > Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**. > Requested by @lolipopshock. Both memory updates landed. Everything is verified and the two inline comments are posted. Here is the synthesis. --- ## Summary of PR/Issue PR #84 adds a dedicated `/forum` page that renders the org's Posts-category GitHub Discussions live in the browser. It fetches from the **unauthenticated** GitHub REST Discussions API (`Accept: application/vnd.github.full+json`, no token), so pre-rendered `body_html` is used directly and no secrets are baked into the static build; responses are cached in `localStorage` for 12h. The page shows a card list, and clicking a card opens `?discussion=` as a full-width post-detail view with a "community post" disclaimer banner. A homepage link is wired via `SubscribeLinks`, and there is a `noscript` fallback. The design is well-reasoned for a static site — the tokenless-REST + client-side-filter tradeoff is the right call given GraphQL would require a credentialed backend. ## Review The feature is well-built, follows existing repo conventions (inline-script wiring, CSS-in-component-string), and handles caching, deep-linking, errors, and no-JS gracefully. I live-verified the core premise — the unauthenticated repo Discussions endpoint returns **HTTP 200** with `body_html`, so there is **no BLOCKING functional issue**. One real UX bug (SPA-router double-fire) and two smaller items are worth addressing before merge. The rubrics lane returned N/A (no rubric set is configured for this repo), so it contributed no code findings. | Issue | Severity | Description | | -- | -- | -- | | In-page links double-fire with Quartz SPA router | WARNING | `.forum-card` / `.forum-back-link` anchors bubble to Quartz's window-level click router (no `defaultPrevented` check), causing a redundant fetch, scroll-to-top, and a **duplicate history entry** so the browser Back button needs two presses. | | Community-authored `body_html` rendered via `innerHTML` | WARNING | Third-party Discussion content is injected as HTML on the hosts' primary domain. Risk is low (GitHub sanitizes server-side; anchors/images hardened), but the trust boundary should be an explicit, accepted decision. | | `parseForumTitle` rejoins title with `"_ "` | WARNING (low) | `join("_ ")` (L63) inserts a literal `"_ "` between segments, corrupting multi-underscore titles. Latent for current content (needs a no-`

` body + extra underscores), but a genuine bug. | | Unauthenticated rate limit (60/hr per IP) | INFO | Cold load costs up to `maxPages` (5) requests; well-mitigated by the 12h cache and single-request short-circuit. Edge case: shared/CGNAT IPs pool the budget. | | Client-side category filter caps at `maxPages × 100` | INFO | Posts beyond the first ~500 discussions across all categories would be missed; acceptable at current scale, truncation note handles UX. | | No unit tests for pure helpers | INFO | `parseForumTitle` / `makeExcerpt` / `escapeForumHTML` / `displayDate` are pure and testable; repo precedent exists (`search.test.ts`). A small test would have caught the title bug. | | PR-description mismatch + minor duplication | INFO | Verification command lists `content/index.md` (not in diff; link actually ships via `SubscribeLinks`). `initForumDiscussions`/`refreshForum` share a fetch→cache→render block. Pre-existing `tsc` errors are unrelated. | ## Progress - **Live-verified working:** unauthenticated `GET /repos/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/discussions` (`full+json`) returned HTTP 200, 19 discussions (2 in `posts`), with `body_html` present — the tokenless design functions; no hidden BLOCKING issue. - **Finding #3 is latent for current content:** the two live posts have single-underscore titles (e.g. `Guest Post_ CongJie Pan_…`), and post bodies with an `

` bypass `parseForumTitle` for display — so the bug does not currently surface, but the fix is still cheap and correct. - **Rubrics review:** N/A — `agent/rubrics` branch absent, `RUBRICS_AVAILABLE=false`; nothing to score. Metadata only, not a code finding. - **No prior review to carry forward:** two earlier `/review` requests (2026-06-17, 2026-07-20) failed to produce output due to a pipeline issue that is now resolved; there are no stale findings to reconcile. - **Inline comments posted (this synthesis):** [L290 — SPA-router double-fire](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/84#discussion_r3618186642) and [L63 — `join("_ ")` bug](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/84#discussion_r3618187311). No existing inline comments/threads existed, so nothing was replied to, resolved, or minimized. ## Issue Details
In-page links double-fire with Quartz SPA router (Back button needs two presses) **Cause:** `.forum-card` (`forum.inline.ts:290`) and `.forum-back-link` (L323) are real `` elements. Their click handlers (L355, L365) call only `event.preventDefault()`. Quartz's global router in [`spa.inline.ts:150`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/scripts/spa.inline.ts#L150) listens on **`window`** and never checks `event.defaultPrevented`, so the event still bubbles up and `navigate()` runs: it re-fetches `/forum`, `micromorph` briefly clears the just-rendered post, `scrollTo({top:0})` overrides the smooth scroll, and a **second** `history.pushState` to the identical `?discussion=N` URL runs. The duplicate entry makes the first Back press appear to do nothing. **Candidate solutions:** Add `data-router-ignore` to both anchors so `getOpts()` bails ([`spa.inline.ts:32`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/scripts/spa.inline.ts#L32)); or call `event.stopPropagation()` in the two click handlers. Then verify Back/Forward between list and post in the Sepo preview. **Comments:** Highest-value finding — small, mechanical fix with an outsized UX payoff on the page's primary interaction.
Community-authored body_html rendered via innerHTML (trust boundary) **Cause:** `prepareForumBody` / `renderSelectedDiscussion` inject GitHub's `body_html` via `innerHTML`. Anyone can open a Posts-category Discussion, so this is third-party content rendered as HTML on the hosts' primary domain. **Candidate solutions:** Accept as-is (GitHub sanitizes `body_html` server-side; the code additionally forces `rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"` + `target="_blank"` on anchors, and all text is routed through `escapeForumHTML`). For defense-in-depth, run `body_html` through a client-side sanitizer (e.g. DOMPurify) — likely more dependency than a static podcast site needs. **Comments:** Not a required code change — the ask is a conscious maintainer sign-off on the "trust GitHub's sanitizer" dependency, so it's a human decision rather than an automation action item.
parseForumTitle rejoins title with "_ " **Cause:** `forum.inline.ts:63` uses `underscoreParts.slice(1).join("_ ")`, inserting a literal `"_ "` between segments. A title like `guest post_Ada_My_Cool_Post` renders as `My_ Cool_ Post`. This is the fallback used when a post body has no `

`. **Candidate solutions:** Use `join(" ")`, or `join("_")` to preserve underscores. A tiny `forum.test.ts` covering `parseForumTitle`/`makeExcerpt` would lock this in (finding #6). **Comments:** Latent for the current two posts, but a clear, zero-risk correctness fix.

INFO notes (rate limit, filter ceiling, tests, description/duplication) **Cause:** (4) Cold load costs up to 5 requests against the 60/hr-per-IP unauthenticated limit; shared/CGNAT IPs pool it. (5) REST returns all categories, so Posts beyond ~`maxPages × 100` are not seen. (6) Pure helpers have no unit tests despite `search.test.ts` precedent. (7) PR description's verification lists `content/index.md` (not in diff; the homepage link actually ships via `SubscribeLinks`), and `initForumDiscussions`/`refreshForum` duplicate a fetch→cache→render block. **Candidate solutions:** All acceptable as-is at current scale. Optional: add `forum.test.ts`; extract the shared fetch/render helper; correct the PR description. Pre-existing `tsc` errors (`EpisodeCarousel.tsx`, `Footer.tsx`, `GuestSuggestion.tsx`) are unrelated to this PR but mean `npm run check` is already red independent of it. **Comments:** Informational; none block merge and none are automation action items.
## Recommended Next Step **FIX_PR** — findings #1 and #3 are concrete, low-risk, line-tied branch changes (add `data-router-ignore`/`stopPropagation`; swap the `join` separator) that are safe for an automated fix-pr pass, with a manual Back/Forward preview check for #1. ## Final Verdict **MINOR_ISSUES** ## Action Items - [ ] Stop `.forum-card` / `.forum-back-link` from double-firing with Quartz's SPA router — add `data-router-ignore` to both anchors (or `event.stopPropagation()` in the handlers), then verify Back/Forward between list and post in the preview. - [ ] Fix `parseForumTitle` (`forum.inline.ts:63`): replace `join("_ ")` with `join(" ")` (or `join("_")` to preserve underscores). --- `claude` | `claude-opus-4-8` | `max` | `GitHub Actions 1000003833`

Applied the minimum fix for the two WARNING-level action items from the review synthesis in [`forum.inline.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/feat/live-github-forum/quartz/components/scripts/forum.inline.ts):

- **SPA-router double-fire (WARNING):** Added `data-router-ignore` to the `.forum-card` and `.forum-back-link` anchors so Quartz's window-level router (`spa.inline.ts:32` bails on `routerIgnore`) no longer re-navigates on top of the in-page handlers — fixes the redundant fetch, scroll override, and duplicate history entry that made Back need two presses.
- **`parseForumTitle` separator bug (WARNING, low):** Changed `join("_ ")` → `join(" ")` (L63) so multi-underscore fallback titles no longer render a stray `"_ "` between segments.

<details><summary>Scope & verification</summary>

- Left untouched (INFO / human-judgment only): `innerHTML` trust-boundary sign-off, rate-limit note, filter ceiling, unit tests, PR-description mismatch.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` reports no forum-related errors (pre-existing unrelated errors in `EpisodeCarousel.tsx` / `Footer.tsx` / `GuestSuggestion.tsx` remain).
- Net diff: 3 insertions, 3 deletions in one file. Not committed — changes left in the working tree.
- The `data-router-ignore` fix should be spot-checked with Back/Forward navigation in the Sepo preview.
</details>
